Headline: #53 Pulaski and #53A South Pulaski buses Temporary Reroute near Pulaski/51st
ShortDescription: #53 Pulaski and #53A South Pulaski buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to a street blockage near Pulaski/51st.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#53 Pulaski and #53A South Pulaski buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to a street blockage near Pulaski/51st.

Northbound buses are rerouted via Pulaski, 55th, Cicero, Archer, Karlov, Orange Line, and Pulaski, then to resume their normal route.
 
Southbound buses are rerouted via Pulaski, Orange Line, Karlov, Archer, Cicero, 55th, Pulaski, then to resume their normal route.

Allow extra travel time.
